Nora: FYI — Evergreen POC seeing sporadic TTFTs and occasional 429s when ramping to ~350rps. Customer says iteels like "first token hang" on cold sessions. Can we triage? :mag:
Jamal: can you share req ids + model/route + client connection pattern (connections per client)?
Nora: route=/v1/generate model=redwood-3b-lite variant=quant-l1 reqs=r_ev_01 r_ev_02 r_ev_03
Nora: clients open 2 persistent connections per instance, prefill=true, prefill_tokens=24, batch_window_ms=12
Theo: thanks. logs please — even 3 lines helps.
Nora: ```
[2026-07-14T08:44:01.120Z] req=r_ev_01 lat_ms=1087 status=200 batch_size=1 kv_hit=false shard=shard-11
[2026-07-14T08:44:01.198Z] req=r_ev_02 lat_ms=46 status=200 batch_size=20 kv_hit=true shard=shard-2
[2026-07-14T08:44:01.605Z] req=r_ev_03 lat_ms=1300 status=429 batch_size=1 kv_hit=false shard=shard-11
```
Theo: pattern = small batch_size + kv_hit=false on slow/429 requests -> likely affinity issue or shard hot/cold. Can someone check shard-11 kv stats and active variants?
Infra-bot: run: redwoodctl debug kv-stats --shard shard-11 --last 30m
Infra-bot: output: kv_hits=22% kv_misses=78% avg_kv_latency_ms=6.5 active_variants=[quant-l1,quant-m2]
Jamal: mixed variants on shard-11 + low kv hit rate. Also their gateway churns keepalives (per Nora). Multiple conns per client + gateway rotation can send prefill to one shard and follow-ups to another -> miss.
Theo: short fixes: 1) enable tenant-affinity for their tenant (server-side) 2) bump prefill_tokens to 96 and batch_window_ms to 45ms during test 3) route by model-variant for POC to avoid variant mixing
Nora: customer asks pricing delta if we suggest Dedicated to meet SLA. They want rough hosted vs Dedicated numbers.
Pricing: ballpark: hosted unit cost for 3b-like workload ~0.0010/token. Small Dedicated (2 GPU equiv) amortized ~0.00058/token at 70% utilization. Final depends on commit/term.
Jamal: Infra plan: flip tenant.affinity=true for tenant=evergreen-tenant for a 30m test, bump pool eviction TTL to 20m, and add +1 shard temporarily. Infra-bot: apply?
Infra-bot: action: tenant.affinity=enabled for tenant=evergreen-tenant; pool evergreen-pool add_shards=1; kv.eviction_ttl=1200s :gear:
Nora: reran test after changes — ~92% requests TTFT < 100ms, outliers remain ~540-900ms, 429s gone. Trace id t_ev_0714_0848 provided.
Theo: checking trace: slow traces show initial kernel fallback then optimized kernel once weights loaded — consistent with variant churn. If tenant-affinity stays on and variant-dedicated routing applied we'll expect <1% outliers.
Jamal: next steps for SE: 1) advise customer to reduce gateway connection churn or use single pinned connection per client 2) keep tenant-affinity enabled for remainder of POC 3) offer Dedicated trial if they want strict SLOs (note: KMS onboarding ~2w)
Nora: will update customer and include pricing ballpark + ask about Dedicated trial. Thanks team :thumbsup:
